post.text:
Si realmente estaban en el espacio… ¿por qué esa pelota nunca empezó a flotar?.

La reacción en sus caras fue de puro pánico cuando se dieron cuenta de que no ocurrió. 😬 https://t.co/5GLzkBY1J8
post.author_description: Pasa un buen rato garantizado. Historias, clips y momentos fascinantes, Lo mejor de X en un solo lugar. @RalphHoracioSSR CUENTA ROBADA ⚠️.

description.description: The video shows five astronauts standing inside a spacecraft, likely the International Space Station, given the visible 'ISS 20' logo and various international flags behind them. They are dressed in matching blue polo shirts and tan trousers. One male astronaut on the far right holds a microphone and a globe, gesturing as if to explain or present something. Red arrows in the first few frames point toward specific areas, such as equipment on the wall, the ISS 20 logo, and the microphone. The scene appears to be a promotional or educational clip, overlaid with social media watermarks like '@LOSTCIVILIZATIONS_' and an all-seeing eye Egyptian symbol in the top right corner.

tweetMedia.transcription: You can see the eye and how it's forming. But one of the things that's interesting about up here, when you see that whole hurricane, you're pretty amazed and you start taking pictures and all of that of it, but then you forget that there are people in danger down on Earth with the hurricanes and all that. So sometimes it's easy to lose perspective.
